verdict.rationale: Osborne Clarke is a law firm selling legal advisory services, not a software platform, so subscribing to events via webhooks is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any programmatic event or callback capability. The probes found no OpenAPI spec or llms.txt, and its online tools (UPC decision tracker, investor-readiness check) are static resources rather than event APIs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
